newsitem.title: USA: Ross Stores May same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Ross Stores May same-store sales rise.

text.p: Ross Stores Inc on Thursday reported sales of $160 million for the four week period ended May 31, 1997, a 24 percent increase above the $129 million in sales for the four weeks ended June 1, 1996. Comparable store sales for the same period increased 15 percent against a nine percent increase in the prior year.

For the four months through May 31, 1997, sales were $602 million, a 20 percent increase above the $500 million in sales for the prior year's comparable period ended June 1, 1996. Comparable store sales for the four month period increased 12 percent against a 13 percent increase in the prior year.
The company had 315 stores at May 31, 1997, compared to 296 stores at the end of the same period last year.
